title: Sanitizer Allowlist Permits KaTeX and MathML Output
description: The frontend module shall permit MathML elements and KaTeX-classed element styles in the section-content sanitizer.
rationale: The existing sanitizer explicitly forbids style attributes and MathML tags on the documented assumption that section content contains no math. That assumption changes with this sprint; the allowlist must be extended to allow exactly the elements and styles that math typesetting produces, or math will be stripped before reaching the DOM.
